哦，对了，有可能会遇到在cis库里面不显示封装的情况，那就需要更改Capture.ini文件里面的DirXX内容，我复制在下面。<br>
<br>
[Allegro Footprints]<br>
Dir0=D:\Cadence\SPB_17.2\share\pcb\pcb_lib\symbols\<br>
Dir1=D:\Cadence\Cadence_CIS\Footprint\Capacitor\Footprint<br>
Dir2=D:\Cadence\Cadence_CIS\Footprint\Capacitor\Pad<br>
Dir3=D:\Cadence\Cadence_CIS\Footprint\Connector\Footprint<br>
Dir4=D:\Cadence\Cadence_CIS\Footprint\Connector\Pad<br>
Dir5=D:\Cadence\Cadence_CIS\Footprint\Diode\Footprint<br>
Dir6=D:\Cadence\Cadence_CIS\Footprint\Diode\Pad<br>
Dir7=D:\Cadence\Cadence_CIS\Footprint\IC\Footprint<br>
Dir8=D:\Cadence\Cadence_CIS\Footprint\IC\Pad<br>
Dir9=D:\Cadence\Cadence_CIS\Footprint\Inductor\Footprint<br>
Dir10=D:\Cadence\Cadence_CIS\Footprint\Inductor\Pad<br>
Dir11=D:\Cadence\Cadence_CIS\Footprint\Misc\Footprint<br>
Dir12=D:\Cadence\Cadence_CIS\Footprint\Misc\Pad<br>
Dir13=D:\Cadence\Cadence_CIS\Footprint\Resistor\Footprint<br>
Dir14=D:\Cadence\Cadence_CIS\Footprint\Resistor\Pad<br>
[Application]<br>
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------<br>
最后最后，建立OCBD的时候要建立64位的，32位的不识别，用户和系统都要建立。<br>
